front: When were the Five Days of Milan?
back: 18-22 March 1848, when Milan forced Radetzky's army to retreat.

front: When was the Battle of Novara?
back: 23 March 1849: Austria crushed Piedmont and Charles Albert abdicated.

front: Who ended the Roman Republic in 1849?
back: French troops sent by Louis Napoleon, who restored the pope.

Why did the pope's announcement of April 1848 matter?
back: Pius IX refused to fight Catholic Austria, ending hopes of a papal-led Italy and weakening the war effort.

front: Why was Italy not unified in 1848-49?
back: Austria's army, divisions among Italians, the pope's withdrawal, little peasant support and French intervention in Rome.
